QuestInfo.name: [Magatia] A Present for Keeny
QuestInfo.1: #p2111003# made a present for #p2111005#. What, he's not human, but he can perform alchemy? \n\nAnyway, #p2111003# made #t4031693#. I didn't think the present seemed girly enough, but in the world of alchemy, this might be the norm... I better give this to #b#p2111005##k right now.
QuestInfo.2: #p2111005# was very ecstatic to receive this gift. She must be really close with #p2111003#.

0.0:
Ah, good thing you are here. I have produced a present for #p2111005#. Take a look at it. It's #t4031693#.

#i4031693##t4031693# 

 #p2111005# is very interested in alchemy, so she'll be very happy with it. Now that the present is ready, can you help me once more by delivering it to her?

yes.0: Thank you so much. Once she finds out you lent a helping hand in making this, #p2111005# will be that much happier. Now please give this to her.

no.0: Oh why? Are you too shy to give it to her? Don't worry about that one bit. Remember, it can also be your present to her.

1.0: Hmm? Do you need me for something? Ehh? This is... wow! It's #t4031693#! This is awesome! Hey, but... are you really giving to me?
1.1: Wow, it really is a present from #p2111003#! Yes! I really wanted one, you know. How did he know? And you helped him make this, too... this is so awesome. Thank you so much! I am so happy right now.

yes.0: Hehe... I better say thanks to #p2111003# too!

npc.0: You haven't gone to see #b#p2111005##k yet? I am sure she'll be ecstatic to see this. Please deliver that to her.

item.0: Hmm? Do you need me for something?

lost.0: You lost #t4031693#? Oh no... good thing I made a spare. Please give this to #p2111005#.
